title: Miso Soup with Onion
description: A simple and comforting Japanese-inspired soup made with miso paste, onions, and a hint of sweetness.

ingredients.name: Bliss (likely a typo for Blissful or Blissful soup noodles)

instructions: Heat the broth in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the miso paste until dissolved.
Add the cooked bliss noodles to the pot.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
